name: lemlist
description: Connect lemlist to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use lemlist MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect lemlist to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with sales outreach campaigns using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my lemlist workspace.
